# 2.56 Corrections, adjustments and scorekeepers: part 1 (builder's note, 2026-11-23)

Brief check: for a league's admin (or scheduler) after a game, on a phone. Done means they reopen a final game with a reason and end it again, the public page says "Corrected" only when the result really changed, and they add or take off an adjustment that shows in the table; every change in the activity log. The line's done test checks a score correction and a deduction; it did not check a slip undone (added, in my browser test).
Stock-take: EXISTED reopenGame / reopenTrackedGame / recordFinalScore (reopen and finalize again, logged), the reopen form on the admin's game page and "Correct this result" on Games, addAdjustment / removeAdjustment (logged), assign/unassignScorekeeper. MISSING: the mark rule, a read of a season's adjustments for the admin, the Admin → Standings and stats screen, the public pencil (H5), assignment screens.

## When a game reads "Corrected" (S-81, decided for you)

- Reopened and ended again with the same score and the same kind of result (a slip undone, within the scorekeeper's minutes or not): no mark.
- Reopened and still open (scheduled again or live in the tracker): no mark from that reopen (the page says "Being corrected", S-47).
- Ended with a different score, or a final turned forfeit (or back): marked, dated by that correction's day in the league's time zone.
- Several reopens: marked if any one changed the result at its next final; dated by the latest that did. A fix later put back to the first score still reads marked (each final differed from the one before).
- Every reopen stays in the activity log (the database test checks two entries).
